title: Add Indish Marketer's Voice Agent to business
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Indish Marketer's Voice Agent](https://voice.prototools.in) to business
- An AI voice agent that businesses embed on their own website. Callers speak naturally instead of filling out a contact form; the agent answers from the business's own knowledge base and captures leads

Fixes #13390

gist.headline: The contact form learned to talk
gist.blurb: Indish Marketer's Voice Agent joined the business garden. Visitors can speak naturally with a website instead of negotiating with another tiny form field.
gist.summary: Added Indish Marketer's Voice Agent to the business app directory, letting businesses embed a voice agent that answers from their knowledge base and captures leads through natural spoken conversations.
gist.impact: Businesses can now discover a voice-first website assistant that turns visitor questions into informed answers and captured leads without requiring a contact form.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a friendly call-center gardener wearing tiny headphones, tending a glowing retro website terminal with a warm speech-wave flower growing from it. A small business storefront and code-plants represent an embeddable agent, while a visitor speech bubble turns into a neatly collected lead card; the Monitor Robot can eagerly hold the lead card.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny headset, helping a cheerful CRT Monitor Robot tend a glowing voice-wave flower growing from a retro business website terminal; a visitor's speech bubble becomes a small lead card beside code-plants and flowers. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel cream-lavender gradient background, warm lighting, chunky retro sprites, subtle scanlines, pixel-font text: "HELLO"; lo-fi retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful.
